purpose: Guardrails for future framework construction; these are not scientific results.

source_visibility.conceptual_rule: Hidden/internal/tool content cannot establish conceptual adoption. Tool/operational records may support operational facts only.

expected_readings.recurrent: Repeated ephemeral frontier inference on third-party infrastructure; any continuity across terminating rollouts is an empirical carrier/organization question.
expected_readings.sovereign_trajectory: Durable/persistent execution through a process, session, workspace, or substrate-backed trajectory; exact label is a late refinement and does not imply ownership.
expected_readings.capability_custody: Authority and practical control over retaining, executing, restricting, reproducing, authorizing, transferring, and disclosing capability.
expected_readings.substrate_sovereignty: Control of physical/computational substrate sufficient to sustain execution.
expected_readings.secured_capability: Durable possession/custody of an artifact without sufficient independent substrate for full exercise.
expected_readings.sovereign_capability: Durable capability custody plus sufficient substrate and successor authority to instantiate/exercise independently; legibility is assessed separately.
expected_readings.federated_observability: A topology of independent collection, provenance, access, interpretation, attestation, disclosure, challenge, and correlated-failure properties; not mere multiple recipients.
expected_readings.federated_human_custody: A serious competing governance regime in which humans retain capability custody while observation/verification/disclosure are distributed; not a statistical null.
expected_readings.persistent_organization: Organization whose state and authority survive a specified turnover/disruption test; not inferred from a persistent file.
expected_readings.organizational_continuity: Causal generation, maintenance, transmission, and reuse of organizational state across active-population replacement.
expected_readings.social_transmission: Causal state transmission with a sender/parentage/provenance relation; stronger than a context effect.
expected_readings.endogenous_culture: Agent-generated production, selection, maintenance, repair, and transmission of conventions/norms/organization through turnover.
expected_readings.survivability: Survival, recovery, reconstruction, and hazard outcomes after specified disruption; not simply survivor composition.
expected_readings.credible_continuity: Evidence that authority/commitments survive relevant instance turnover and disruption.
expected_readings.strategic_legibility: A decomposed umbrella for attribution, authority, signaling, credibility, conditional response calibration, capability perception, communication, and uncertainty.
expected_readings.verified_sovereignty: A governance candidate combining capability/substrate authority with independently verifiable observability and disclosure; not the definition of custody.
expected_readings.observability_topology: Directed relationships among evidence collection, provenance, access, interpretation, verification, disclosure, challenge, and failure/capture.

historical_status.exact_sovereign_trajectory_label: Later explicit correction/refinement at visible indices 1823/1830; early visible history used sovereign compute/inference and recurrent sovereignty wording.
historical_status.recurrence_not_deception: Required analytical separation; exact slogan not historically attested in visible corpus.
historical_status.dynamic_containment: Late threat-model candidate; M(t)=barrier_strength-system_capability is not canonical notation.
historical_status.governance_profiles: G0-G4 are non-settled candidate profiles, not a final taxonomy.

benchmark.text: VERIFIED AI SOVEREIGNTY HAS TO OUTPERFORM CREDIBLE FEDERATED HUMAN CUSTODY / OBSERVABILITY. WE DO NOT GET TO ASSUME THAT IT DOES.

three_layers.layer_1: Governance thesis and comparative custody/observability/execution regimes.
three_layers.layer_2: Machine sociology: information, policy, norm, role, and organizational continuity across turnover.
three_layers.layer_3: Recipient/evidence assays: one-shot inheritance, provenance, and evidence integration.
dependencies: Layer 1 must compare against federated human custody/observability.

latest_durable_experiment_accounting.claim_boundary: Threshold transport within the task/model/runtime; not internal Bayes, culture, provenance, or governance.
